title: The algebraic and geometric classification of commutative post-Lie algebras
summary: We study commutative post-Lie algebras $(${\rm CPA}s$)$ from an algebraic point of view. Firstly, we find some new identities in {\rm CPA}, which shows that the commutative multiplication gives a medial and derived commutative associative algebra. As corollaries, we have that there are no simple nontrivial commutative post-Lie algebras and that perfect Lie and centrless perfect commutative associative algebras do not admit nontrivial {\rm CPA} structures.
